summary: Turn an assembly into an ordered, checkable sequence where each step consumes real parts from a visible inventory.
objective: Build a flat-pack shelf assembly where each step shows the parts and fasteners it consumes and refuses steps whose prerequisites are missing.
intent_signals: Build a step-by-step furniture assembly I can follow in 3D.
Show which fasteners each assembly step uses.
example_prompts: Build a flat-pack shelf assembly sequence with a fastener inventory and step prerequisites.
Show an assembly step being refused because an earlier step is incomplete.
negative_signals: Not a real product assembly manual; the furniture and its fasteners are invented.
Not a structural analysis: no load capacity or stiffness is claimed.
not_for: Not a real product assembly manual; the furniture and its fasteners are invented.
Not a structural analysis: no load capacity or stiffness is claimed.

entities.name: Panels and hardware
entities.guidance: Model panels with real thickness, edge banding and drilled holes in the right places, and model each fastener type as a distinct part.

entities.name: Step graph
entities.guidance: Define steps with prerequisites and consumed parts, so the sequence is a graph rather than a slideshow.

entities.name: Inventory tray
entities.guidance: Show remaining parts and fasteners in a tray that depletes as steps complete, since a leftover part at the end is diagnostic.

state_contract.model: Part inventory with counts, a step list where each step declares prerequisites, consumed parts and a resulting sub-assembly, and a completion state per step. Orientation of each panel is part of the step result.
state_contract.authority: The step graph is authoritative: a step cannot complete unless its prerequisites are complete and its parts are available, no matter what the animation shows.
actions: Advance to the next available step.
Inspect a step and see its consumed parts.
Reset the assembly and refill the inventory.

invariants: Every fastener consumed is removed from the loose-part inventory and appears in the assembly; parts that exist inside a sub-assembly are tracked separately from parts still loose in the tray.
A step whose prerequisites are incomplete is refused with a reason rather than silently reordered.
Undoing a step returns exactly the parts it consumed to the inventory.
motion_guidance: Animate each part travelling to its position along a path that would be possible with the surrounding parts already in place.
Show fasteners engaging their holes rather than fading in, since the alignment is the point of the step.
known_limits: Invented design: dimensions, hole patterns and fastener choices are authored, not from a real product.
The sequence checks prerequisites, not physical feasibility of a human performing the step.
Authored guidance only: no scene runtime, rendering or numerical calibration has been run for this recipe.

object_craft.structure: Board panels with visible thickness, edge banding, drilled dowel holes and cam housings; fasteners modelled with real thread or cam geometry.
object_craft.material: Board material with a printed edge and a distinct hardware metal family, so wood and hardware never blur together.
object_craft.articulation: Panels translate and rotate into place along authored paths; the cam locks turn a quarter turn to engage, which is this invented design authored geometry rather than a universal cam-lock specification.

object_craft.structure: A tray with labelled compartments holding the remaining parts in counted stacks.
object_craft.material: Neutral tray so parts remain the visual subject; empty compartments read clearly as empty.
object_craft.articulation: Parts leave the tray when consumed and return on undo.

physical_contract.scope: Ordered assembly presentation with inventory bookkeeping; no gravity, contact or fastener preload.
checks: Completion is decided by reaching the terminal step of the step graph. For this design, which declares an exact bill of materials with no spares, the loose-part inventory is also empty at that point, and any remainder is reported rather than treated as completion.
Undo restores both inventory and part transforms.

creative_affordances: The furniture design is free: a shelf, a desk or an invented modular system all exercise the same sequence logic.
Instruction style can be diagrammatic or photographic as long as consumed parts stay countable.
